title: Should Students Have Homework?
text:
Many teachers believe that homework helps students practise what they learn in class. In my opinion, a small amount of homework is useful because it encourages regular study and builds discipline. Short exercises after school allow pupils to review grammar and vocabulary while the lessons are still fresh in their minds. Furthermore, completing tasks independently helps learners become more responsible.

However, homework should not become a heavy burden. When students receive hours of tasks every evening, they have little time for sport, family and rest. As a result, many become tired and lose motivation. Therefore, I think schools should set moderate amounts of homework that focus on quality rather than quantity.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what do short exercises after school allow pupils to do?
What does the writer say happens when students receive hours of tasks every evening?
options: They become tired and lose motivation.

questions.text: What can be inferred about the writer's view of homework?
options: Homework is useful when it is moderate.
Teachers should give much more homework.

questions.text: Why does the writer mention family and rest in paragraph two?
options: To show that students need time outside school.
To argue that families should replace teachers.
To suggest that sport is more important than study.
To explain why schools are closing.

paragraph_translations: Muitos professores acreditam que o dever de casa ajuda os alunos a praticar o que aprendem em sala de aula. Na minha opinião, uma pequena quantidade de dever de casa é útil, porque incentiva o estudo regular e desenvolve a disciplina. Exercícios curtos depois da escola permitem que os alunos revisem gramática e vocabulário enquanto as aulas ainda estão frescas na memória. Além disso, completar tarefas de forma independente ajuda os estudantes a se tornarem mais responsáveis.

No entanto, o dever de casa não deve se tornar um fardo pesado. Quando os alunos recebem horas de tarefas todas as noites, têm pouco tempo para esporte, família e descanso. Como resultado, muitos ficam cansados e perdem a motivação. Por isso, penso que as escolas deveriam definir quantidades moderadas de dever de casa, com foco na qualidade e não na quantidade.
